name: photo-to-travel-sketch
title_zh: 把一张照片变成松弛感旅行手绘速写
tagline_zh: 厌倦了写实修图？让照片变成钢笔淡彩速写：断续黑线、留白构图、灰调淡色，像旅行中随手画下的记忆，而不是滤镜。
tagline_en: Tired of realistic edits? Turn photos into loose pen-and-marker travel sketches—broken contours, bold omission.
desc_en: Convert a user-provided photo into a fast, loose observational travel sketch using economical wandering black contours, aggressive omission, dry fiber-tip marker strokes, source-aware but gray-muted color, and naive compressed perspective. Use when the user asks to turn a photo, streetscape, building, landscape, or travel memory into a spontaneous personal sketchbook, urban-sketch, pen-and-marker,
why_zh: 不是风格迁移贴纸，而是按速写逻辑重画：先抽线条、再压透视、最后叠灰彩，每一步都保留手绘的犹豫与果断。
why_en: Not a style-transfer filter—it redraws with sketch logic: extract lines, compress perspective, mute color, preserving the.
limit_zh: 只认单张照片（JPG/PNG），不处理多图合成或视频帧；输出为静态图，不生成动画或分层文件；建筑细节密集的图会过度简化。
limit_en: Single photo only (JPG/PNG); no video frames or composites. Output is a static image—no animation or layered files. Dense architecture may.
